These Appeals, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

1. The owner is in appeals contending that fastening of liability on the owner in light of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Mukund Dewangan Vs. Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd - (2017) 14 SCC 663, would be incorrect.

entities.text: Mukund Dewangan Vs. Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd - (2017) 14 SCC 663
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. In these cases, it is not in dispute that the driver of the offending vehicle possessed Light Motor Vehicle licence but did not possess a requisite endorsement to drive the offending vehicle.

3. The judgment rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of 'Mukund Dewangan' (supra)
would therefore squarely apply to the facts and circumstance of these cases.
Hence, the appeals are allowed and the fastening of liability on the owner is set aside.
4. It is made clear that the insurer would be liable to satisfy the compensation.
5. The amount deposited by the owner shall be refunded to the owner online to the account of the owner as per the details provided by him.
